description: Ownership of an Entra object (app, SP, or group) - a standing right, not an action.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'No event for merely holding ownership; the abuse (Add credential/owner/member) is what logs.' (directory logging is default-on).

abuse_primitive: Ownership itself is passive; exercise it via AZAddSecret / AZAddOwner / AZAddMembers.
notes: Scored low because it is the right, not the act - the chosen follow-on action sets the real detection cost.
